operator: KA Andalan Celebes / KA Lontara (Makassar–Parepare commuter rail)
notes: Makassar–Parepare commuter rail operated by Konsorsium KA Sulawesi Selatan (PT KAI 70% / PT Sulsel Citra Indonesia 30%), running since 1 Jul 2024. Two published services: KA Andalan Celebes (Mangilu<->Garongkong, avg travel 1h12m) and KA Lontara (Mandai<->Palanro ~95km and Mandai<->Garongkong ~79km, avg travel 1h53m-2h33m). Sources give frequency ("1x round trip / route", "two departures daily: morning & afternoon; ticket offices open 07:00 WITA") but NO exact per-station clock times were published in the accessible HTML — no timetable table was present on kabarmakassar or Wikipedia. Stop_times are therefore SYNTHESIZED from published average travel times + the morning/afternoon pattern + even inter-station spacing; they reflect the correct station order and realistic durations but are NOT verbatim from the operator's timetable (hence confidence 0.55). Station coordinates are WGS-84 from id.wikipedia/Wikidata infoboxes (all 13 served stations verified). Route ordering: main line runs ...Barru->Takkalasi->Mangkoso->Palanro with Garongkong on a short branch off Barru; Mangilu is a branch off the Ma'rang area (Semen Tonasa). Only stations evidenced as served by the two trains are included; under-construction stations (Tallo, Parangloe, Bungoro, Lumpue, Soreang) are excluded. Ridership context: 116k+ pax Jan-May 2025 (antaranews). SOURCES: en/id Wikipedia (railway + per-station pages), Wikidata, kabarmakassar, antaranews.
